name: spoke
description: SPOKE protocol monorepo — JSON Schema SSOT with generated TypeScript and Rust types

scripts.verify-codegen: pnpm run codegen && node tooling/codegen/assert-schema-count.mjs && git diff --exit-code -- packages/spoke-schemas/src/generated crates/spoke-schemas/src/generated
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-schemas typecheck && pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-operations typecheck && pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-connect typecheck && pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-demo-server typecheck && pnpm -F @42ch/spoke-demo-client typecheck
scripts.ci:typescript: pnpm run build:schema && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:fixtures && pnpm run test:connect-ts && pnpm run build:operations && pnpm run test:release && pnpm run test:demo
